semiconductor_relevance: High — Maverick Engineering Company manufactures precision grinding and polishing machines specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Maverick Engineering Company specializes in the manufacturing of advanced grinding and polishing machines, including single and dual side flat lap and polish machines, for the semiconductor industry. With over 22 years of experience, they provide equipment designed to achieve high surface quality for various wafer materials.
capabilities: Single and dual side flat lap and polish machines
Dual and single side fine grinding machines
Oscillating type grind and polish machines

regional_presence.India: The company is located near Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and is involved in manufacturing under the Make in India policy.
